visual_text: A question to ask: what would you advise if I were 20 years younger?
Reasons about you: how long any benefit would take; your health and other conditions; what you want from treatment
Only the number: ask what the reasoning is
Time to benefit of cancer screening: Lee et al., BMJ 2013
